name: Headroom
summary: Compresses tool outputs, logs and files before they reach the model; library, proxy and MCP modes. Rejected on negative evidence: the vendor claims about 20%, but two sponsor-run tests found cost +52.8% on long sessions (THOL) and +44% (Dasein); OptScale's vendor-run write-up found -8.2%. Native output caps and large MCP results saved to a file cover the job.

evidence.setting: Vendor claim in the repository; no method recorded
Sponsor-run leaderboard (THOL), long sessions; quality results not recorded in the v8 docs, so no higher than E5

evidence.source: https://optscale.ai/blog/context-compression-coding-agents (OptScale blog: context compression for coding agents)
evidence.setting: Vendor-run by OptScale, which sells a competing compressor; quality for Headroom not recorded in the v8 docs

revisit: an independent paired test with lower cost per accepted task, with nothing in the request path
maintenance: Third-party project created 2026-01-07; release cadence not reviewed.
